projects.name: Dummerstorf
projects.thesis: A 240 MW AI-oriented data-center project by Schwarz materially expands Germany's sovereign AI and cloud infrastructure pipeline. It is strategically relevant for future accelerator, server, HBM, server-DRAM, enterprise-SSD, networking and power demand, but should not change the current stress index before procurement, BOM or hardware deployment becomes concrete.
watchMetrics: IT load / MW ramp by phase
Enterprise SSD capacity and supplier selection
Potential links to Lübbenau and broader sovereign-AI strategy
commercialTriggers: Named system integrator or server OEM
projects.nextAction: Track hardware, BOM, procurement and supplier announcements; upgrade to active commercial opportunity when a concrete platform, tender or supplier qualification emerges.

projects.name: K+S / Accenture Underground Datacenter
projects.location: Germany – K+S underground mining sites; exact deployment sites to be confirmed
projects.purpose: Secure sovereign cloud, critical infrastructure and potential AI workloads
projects.thesis: K+S and Accenture are evaluating underground mining infrastructure as a new German data-center model. Existing large underground areas, physical protection and local energy infrastructure could create a differentiated sovereign and high-security compute tier. The concept is commercially relevant for server, DRAM, enterprise-SSD, networking and potentially accelerator demand if announced capacity converts into concrete IT deployments.
projects.strategicInterpretation: The project is also a signal of increasing pressure on conventional German data-center development: power availability, land, permitting, security and community acceptance are becoming sufficiently constraining that industrial brownfield and underground infrastructure are being considered as serious alternatives.
technicalRisks: Heat rejection and liquid-cooling architecture underground
Server and spare-parts logistics at 500–1000 m depth
Power expansion from local 20 MW toward stated aggregate potential
watchMetrics: Server OEM and system integrator selection
commercialTriggers: Specific site selected for datacenter deployment
Confirmed IT load above pilot scale
projects.upgradeRule: Upgrade from emerging-project-watch to high-priority-watch when a specific site plus committed IT capacity, named customer, procurement process or hardware platform is confirmed.
projects.nextAction: Track K+S and Accenture announcements for concrete sites, MW commitments, cooling design, anchor customers and hardware procurement. Treat high-security sovereign workloads as the most plausible initial commercial niche; do not assume hyperscale AI suitability until density and cooling are demonstrated.
